field_separator.description: Field delimiter character (e.g., ',', ':', '\t'); must be a single character.

output_delimiter.description: Output field delimiter. If empty, defaults to field_separator.

header_in.description: Treat first input line as column headers.

header_out.description: Print column headers in output (first line).

group_fields.description: List of fields to group by. Values are field indices (1-based) or header names. E.g., ['1', '3'] or ['Name', 'Category'].

operations.description: List of operations to perform. Each item specifies an operation and optional field(s). See 'AVAILABLE OPERATIONS' in manpage for valid operation names (e.g., 'sum', 'mean', 'countunique', 'groupby'). Field can be omitted for primary operations like 'crosstab' or 'transpose'. Field supports ranges (e.g., '2-4') and comma-separated lists (e.g., '1,6'). For operations requiring a pair of fields (e.g., 'pcov'), use colon syntax (e.g., '2:6').

collapse_delimiter.description: Delimiter used in collapse/unique list output.

round_places.description: Number of decimal places to round numeric output (applies to all numeric results).

narm.description: Skip NA/NaN values in numeric operations.

seed.description: Random seed for operations using randomness (e.g., 'rand', 'strbin').

whitespace_delimiter.description: Use whitespace (spaces/tabs) as field delimiter instead of TAB.

zero_terminated.description: End lines with null byte (0x00) instead of newline.
